comments.author: Miyo
comments.body:
NC ships' design is so random.

First it's the name confusion, it must be hard for new players to remember NC ships. Custom and Modified could've been differentiated as one for low level requirement another for higher level, or one lower tier (less OP) than the other, or whatever, but no it's all just random. Then Ambush is a name for NC ships but it's also used in non NC ships like Ambush Atakebune is not NC. And if all FCV have a word before them H-FCV, A-FCV, F-FCV, M-FCV, then why is it FC-F-V?

Ok and then with number of mods, why do AV get 10/10 anyway? Why do HFCV get 6/6 but CAV only get 5/5? Who would use CAV anyway? If its stats bonus are negligible and it cannot be improved more than normal Armoured Vaiss then the non NC version is better cause it can use Official Hull. Who the hell designed CAV?
